figure.name: Babe Ruth
figure.breakdown: In 1927 Babe Ruth hit sixty home runs and became the most replayed figure in a game most fans knew through print. His bylined column ran in syndication, much of it ghostwritten, and radio was beginning to carry him into rooms the stadium never reached. The 1920s press manufactured a 'hot romance' and he was its star.

persona.title: The boy band
persona.why: Assembled for a market, with fan clubs, fan voting and fan-financed releases. A manufactured persona is still a persona, and this is the case where the manufacturing is documented rather than inferred.

character.title: He did not ask to be buried as Dracula
character.why: A man interred in his character's costume, where the costume's owner chose nothing at all: his son and mother decided. played-role because the entry is entirely about where a role ends and a person starts.

companion.title: A team built to answer a competitor
companion.why: A set of characters whose behaviour was specified against a measurement of the audience rather than invented and then found, which is the social-agent case - a far side calibrated to what the person on this side already wants.

divine.title: The Book of My First Showings
divine.why: Dictated by Margery Kempe describing her experiences of Christ's love, her suffering, and her certainty that she had been chosen. The oldest surviving parasocial document on the site, and the reason DIVINE had to be built.

institution.title: Transnational fandom
institution.why: Fans organising across national borders around media, with a shared calendar of releases and a shared language. A body that ignores the state, which is why it is institutional rather than a sub-culture.

cosmology.title: The anime import boom
cosmology.why: The subject is a body of work crossing a border and acquiring a fandom that then organises around it. The attachment is to a canon with no author present, which is what makes the transnational part matter.

officer.title: The local news anchor
officer.why: One person on your own television, in your own town, for twenty years, who is leaving and everybody is upset. Proximity, not charisma, and the clearest case of the attachment accruing from duration.

predator.title: Fandom wars
predator.why: Organised conflict between fanbases with brigading, ratioing and coalition behaviour, conducted with the grammar of war. Two attachments turned on each other, which is the only new thing the contest register does.
